printed_value: In silico mixing of GRAIL-cohort cancer and healthy reads (70% training, 30% validation; mixtures 50:50 to 1:99 at 100 M reads) showed all metrics losing AUROC as ctDNA fraction fell, with depth at all exons best; at 0.0001-0.001 ctDNA fraction many AUROCs approached 0.5. The values are shown only in Figure 6B and are not stored as results.
